info.name: BG1 - Invitation + Password + Frontline Onboarding (BG1.1 PIN-first refinement)
info.description:
Canonical BG1 + BG1.1 collection. Covers invitation lifecycle, password lifecycle, frontline onboarding (now PIN-first by default - phone + name primary identity, email optional), and manager Quick PIN admin (status / reset / disable / enable). Mirrors AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R1-R20. Re-import after any script change (R8).

Locked rules verified:
- /api/auth/me remains canonical context source (R14).
- POST /api/auth/login accepts [200, 201] (R12).
- Invitation tokens returned plaintext ONCE; only SHA-256 hash is stored.
- Re-accepting an accepted invitation returns 409.
- Reset tokens single-use; consuming revokes all active sessions.
- Frontline onboard with enablePasswordLogin=true sets mustChangePassword=true; force-password-change clears it.
- BG1.1 frontline onboard PIN-only (no email, phone-first) returns authMode=PIN_ONLY, mustChangePassword=false, hasSyntheticEmail=true; quick-pin shown ONCE.
- BG1.1 Quick PIN admin endpoints (auth:quick-pin:read|write) never leak stored PIN; reset/disable/enable are audited.

item.name: README - variables, run order, locked rules

request.description:
Run folders in order:
A. Auth & Context Baseline [STANDALONE]
B. Invitation Lifecycle [STANDALONE] - create, resend, accept, re-accept (409), revoke-after-accept (409).
C. Password Lifecycle [STANDALONE] - forgot-password (generic 200), reset-password, double-consume (409).
D. Frontline Staff Onboarding [STANDALONE] - one-call user+role+membership+employee+pin (PIN+password mode), missing-branch 400.
E. Login + /api/auth/me Handoff [STANDALONE] - login as onboarded user, force-password-change clears flag.
F. BG1.1 Frontline PIN-only Onboarding + Quick PIN Admin [STANDALONE] - phone-first PIN-only onboard, GET status (no PIN leak), reset (rotates PIN, old PIN fails), disable (login blocked), enable (login restored).
G. BG1.1 Quick PIN Login Handoff [STANDALONE] - /api/auth/quick-pin-login with rotated PIN, then /api/auth/me on PIN access token.

Auto-populated variables: bg1Suffix, inviteEmail, frontlineEmail, accessToken, orgId, branchId, frontlinePinPhone, frontlinePinEmployeeId, frontlinePinUserId, quickPinValue, quickPinRotated, frontlinePinAccessToken.

Locked decisions:
- /api/auth/me canonical (R14).
- /api/auth/login accepts [200, 201] (R12).
- Invitation token returned plaintext ONCE; only SHA-256 hash stored.
- Reset token single-use; consuming revokes all active sessions.
- BG1.1: PIN never readable from status; reset returns PIN once and invalidates the prior PIN; disable rejects PIN login; enable restores it.
